songs.words:

We’ll follow, we’ll follow, we’ll follow
‘Cause we support
The U.S., the U.S., the U.S.
And that’s the way
We like it, we like it, we like it

songs.title: Over There
songs.words:
Over There, over there
Send the word, send the word
Over there
That the Yanks are coming
The Yanks are coming
The drums rum tumming everywhere
So prepare
Say a prayer, Send the word
Send the word to beware
We’ll be over, We’re coming over
And we won’t be back till it’s over,
Over there

songs.title: We Stand United
songs.words:
Here we stand united,
We’ll never be divided.
Fight and sing for victory
For every generation
Who represent our nation
And battle for the USA!
Here we are, WE ARE, United States
And we all, WE ALL, can celebrate
That we are, WE ARE, United States,
And we’re proud to be the USA!

songs.words: Oh to, Oh to be, Oh to be a Yankee!

songs.title: C’mon U.S., Score A Goal
songs.words:
(Yankee Doodle Dandy)
C’mon US score a goal,
It’s really very simple.
Put the ball into the net
And we’ll go very mental.
La la la…

songs.title: This Land Is Your Land
songs.words:
This land is your land,
This land is my land
From California,
To the New York Island
From the redwood forest,
To the Gulf Stream waters
This land was made for you and me!

songs.title: My Country Tis of Thee
songs.words:
My Country tis of thee
Sweet land of Liberty
Of thee I sing.
Land where my fathers died
Land of the Pilgrim’s pride
From every mountainside
Let freedom ring.

songs.title: God Bless America
songs.words:
God bless America, land that I love.
Stand beside her and guide her
Thru the night with the light from above.
From the Mountains, to the prairies,
To the oceans white with foam.
God bless America, My home sweet home.
God bless America, My home sweet home.

songs.title: America the Beautiful
songs.words:
Oh beautiful for spacious skies,
For amber waves of grain,
For purple mountain majesties
Above the fruited plain.
America, America,
God shed his grace on thee
And crown thy good with brotherhood
From sea to shining sea!

songs.title: Piano Man
songs.words:
(Billy Joel)
Score us a goal, You’re the USA
Score us a goal tonight
‘Cause we’re all in the mood for a victory
And you got us feeling alright
La da da-di-da, La da da-di-da da, 2! 3! 4!

songs.words:

I just can’t get enough (x2)
All the things you do to me and all the things you say
I just can’t get enough (x2)
We slip and slide and we fall in love
And I just can’t seem to get enough of you
Do do do…

songs.title: We All Cheer for the Red, White, & Blue
songs.words:
(Yellow Submarine by The Beatles)
In the land that I call home
Was a team with trophies three,
And they told us of their life
In the land of victory!
We all go to every match,
Outlaws proud, faithfully,
To stand and cheer our women’s team
In the land of victory!
We all cheer for the red, white, and blue
